decisions.reason: As a renamed and improved trommel screen based on an already proven machine concept, it likely remains a stable part of the core screening portfolio and would not normally be withdrawn now.
The mobile high-speed flail shredder line matches the firm's mobile recycling focus and, having remained in the range for several years, would usually be kept unless demand had clearly disappointed.

This mobile high-speed grinder is close to the firm's core applications and is likely to stay on the market, though its lower visibility suggests a somewhat higher review risk than the most prominent lines.

The green-waste grinder variant serves an important composting and biomass niche, but as a more specialized and less emphasized offer it has the highest chance of being rationalized if resources are needed elsewhere.
The stationary single-shaft pre-shredder line fits the firm's established shredding and plant business well and would typically be retained as part of a long-life industrial machinery portfolio.
